purpose: Make public language verifiable at three distinct boundaries: authored source, rendered static artifact, and deployed GitHub Pages response. A passing source check alone is not evidence that the page visitors receive is current or compliant.

repository.staticOutputLayout: root route maps to index.html; every other public route maps to <route>/index.html; /404 maps to 404.html

proof.purpose: The proof binds the deployed response to the exact built HTML and commit. It prevents a successful live style scan from silently approving a stale deployment.

releaseOrder: verify public-copy inventory against route map and content directory
verify rendered static output and write proof
verify the live proof commit, response hashes and rendered language
nonGoals: Using typography or phrase patterns to infer authorship.
Making a network request part of ordinary pull-request CI.
Treating a successful deployment as proof of product capability.
